name: binance_spot_ticker_ts
description: Fetches real-time 24h price statistics, L2 order-book depth (bids/asks) and recent trades for any Binance spot pair, using the public REST API that needs no API key.

symbol.description: Binance spot pair, e.g. BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT. BTC/USDT and btc-usdt are accepted and normalised.

limit.description: Order-book levels and recent trades to return per side, 1-100.
